court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: CRL OP No. 3877 of 2023 and CRL MP Nos. 2450 & 2452 of 2023
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, to call for the entire records pertains to in C.C. No. 3723 of 2019 pending on the file of the Metropolitan Magistrate No. II, Fast Track Court at Saidapet, Chennai - 15 and to quash the same as illegal.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.K. Ilanthiraiyan, J.:— Today, when the matter was taken up for consideration, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the accused was found guilty and convicted for the offence under Section 138 of Negotiable Instruments Act by the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Fast Track Court-III, Saidapet, Chennai and sentenced him to undergo simple imprisonment of six months under Section 255(2) of CrPC The accused was ordered to pay cheque amount as compensation to the complainant under Section 357(3) of CrPC in default to undergo simple imprisonment of one month.

2. In view of the above, the prayer made in this petition has rendered infructuous. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as infructuous. Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
